host.description: Mail host name (MAILCOW_HOSTNAME): the name of the SMTP and IMAP server, of its certificate and of the web UI, like 'mail.example.org'

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate. Postfix and Dovecot use it as well.

http2https.title: HTTP to HTTPS redirection
http2https.description: Redirect all the HTTP requests to HTTPS

netfilter_mode.title: netfilter-mailcow mode
netfilter_mode.description: disabled: netfilter-mailcow does not run. external: it only keeps the mailcow ban list (Manage Fail2Ban externally), served at https://HOST/f2b-banlist.php?id=BANLIST_ID. rootful: it bans attackers itself, in the network namespace of the mailcow pod. If omitted, the current value is kept (default: external).

clamd_enabled.title: ClamAV
clamd_enabled.description: Run the ClamAV antivirus. It needs about 1 GB of RAM more. If omitted, the current value is kept (default: true).
